quote: The US $4.8 million budget for 2025, fully funded by Freeport, is an increase of 14% compared with 2024 … Freeport can earn an 80% interest in the Sierra Azul Copper-Silver Project in two stages by spending an aggregate amount of $50 million and paying a total of $1.55 million in cash to Max.
note: Opened Max Resource 25 Feb 2025 Sierra Azul assay / Freeport budget release.
